_comment: Illustrative normalized TripRequest for the raw input in xiaohongshu_beijing_sample.md. This is what an agent driving this skill should produce after running extract_places_from_text() and then classifying places against the user's stated goals (first-time visitor, relaxed pace, photo spots, no shopping, skip viral spots that require long queues). It is not auto-loadable as-is - build a TripRequest in Python and construct Place objects from it (see examples/run_example.py).
user_goals: first time in Beijing, wants classic attractions
willing to skip viral restaurants if they waste too much time

high_priority_places.name: 景山公园
notes: best photo of Forbidden City skyline

rejectable_at_intake.name: 慕田峪长城
rejectable_at_intake.reason: user said trip is relaxed / only 4 days - a Great Wall day trip would consume an entire day and conflicts with 'not too rushed'; flagged for user confirmation rather than auto-included

must_eat_places.name: 四季民福烤鸭店(故宫店)

南锣鼓巷.notes: user is fine skipping this if the queue looks long - matches 'willing to skip viral restaurants/spots if they waste too much time'
